title: Tabor ONE Fiber Matrix + Tabor Track Baller
designPrinciples: Keep directional topology separate from lock bit
Capture event provenance via ISO-8601 UTC timestamp
12 craft adapters share identical event interface

trackball.gesture: one-finger drag on preview or Track Baller pad

pinch.gesture: two-finger distance change on preview or pad
pinch.outward: decrease modeled tension / open visual gaps

longPress.action: select nearest projected strand and dim others

voice.notes: speech recognition depends on browser and mic permission

simulationCaveat: Illustrative procedural 3D topology; NOT an exact cloth solver, tensile-strength measurement, physical device calibration, or guarantee against unraveling
